title: Reject unknown top-level fields when decoding remote verification requests
outcome: The remote verification request decode boundary rejects unexpected top-level fields without changing encoded native completion facts or association semantics.
acceptance: A behavioral decode test rejects an otherwise valid remote_verification_record control request with an extra top-level field, while the same request without that field round-trips successfully.
Existing SourceId-only request, required nullable endpoint, frame-boundary and receipt behavior remains unchanged.
